description_en: Saves user feedback on chatbot responses
description_zh: 保存用户对于问答结果的评价
kebab_example: aliyun chatbot feedback --message-id 5ca40988-4f99-47ad-ac96-9060d0f81db9 --feedback good --session-id 7c3cec23cc8940bc9db4a318c8f4f0aa --feedback-content 'content_:_我觉得这个答案不对，需要依据事实回答。_,_feedbackLabels_:_存在事实性错误' --instance-id chatbot-cn-mp90s2lrk00050 --agent-key ac627989eb4f8a98ed05fd098bbae5_p_beebot_public --api-version 2022-04-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: Feedback

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of a single message within the session
parameters.name: message_id

parameters.help_en:
The feedback rating for the response. This parameter corresponds to `FeedbackType` in the session history API.

Enumerated values: 'good' (a positive rating) and 'bad' (a negative rating)
parameters.help_zh:
点赞或点踩，对应会话历史API中的FeedbackType

枚举值：
good（点赞）
bad（点踩）
parameters.name: feedback

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier for the session. The instant messaging (IM) system uses this ID to track the conversation
parameters.help_zh: 会话Session标识，标识：IM唯一标识会话
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: The detailed feedback content. You can provide this as a raw string or as a JSON string. If you use a JSON string, the 'content' field corresponds to 'FeedbackUserInfo' and the 'feedbackLabels' field corresponds to 'FeedbackLabels' in the session history
parameters.help_zh: 点赞、点踩的内容，可以直接输入反馈的内容；也可以传入示例中的jsonString，content字段对应会话历史中的FeedbackUserInfo，feedbackLabels对应会话历史中的FeedbackLabels
parameters.name: feedback_content

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the chatbot instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The key for the business space. If this parameter is not set, the system uses the default business space. You can obtain the key from the business management page of your primary account
parameters.help_zh: 业务空间key，不设置则访问默认业务空间，key值在主账号业务管理页面获取
parameters.name: agent_key
